plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-11 from the official Southern Utah University 2026-2027 General Catalog (current edition, catoid=28) Sociology (BA/BS) program page and its linked official degree map, 'Sociology Degree Maps (2026-2027)', Sociology (Campus) tab, last updated/reviewed July 31, 2026. Semester placement is the university's official sample 4-year campus academic plan (SUU Program Maps, 2026-2027), which the source itself labels a guide only; students confirm specifics in Degree Works with a Student Success Advisor. Collected as the B.S.: the catalog prints a single combined line, Total Credits, BA/BS Degree: 120, which the map matches exactly; the map expressly does not include the B.A.'s 16-credit foreign-language requirement (the B.S. requirement is 12 credits of math or science). Every semester's courses sum to the map's printed semester total (15 in all eight semesters) and the plan to 120. Cross-check: the catalog's Sociology Curriculum totals 31 credits (Required Sociology Courses 10, one 9-credit track, Sociology Electives 12), and every named required course appears in the map. The catalog requires completing one of three named 9-credit tracks (Track 1: Crime Research, Prevention, and Policy; Track 2: Social Issue Research and Institutions; Track 3: Work, Economy, and Community, each with its own named course list); the map does not name a track and instead prints three generic track elective rows, recorded as choice slots as printed. The 12 elective credits are the map's four generic upper-division elective slots (the catalog allows up to 6 credits of SUU Anthropology courses to substitute). The map prints SOC 2001's title as 'Sociology as a Major & Career'; the catalog title is recorded. The map's Year 2 Fall quantitative literacy row is printed as 'MATH' with no course number and is recorded as a GE choice slot. GE and elective rows printed without course codes are recorded as choice slots with synthetic codes.
